context: A uni student helps a teen friend plan a craft weekend
purpose: Teach: サーフィン/シャンプー/ピラミッド/食器/名曲/唄/大家/染め

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、週末、染め物と陶芸の食器作り、一緒に行きません?
lines.en: Senpai, would you want to come with me this weekend? There's a dye workshop and pottery class to make dishes.
lines.style: Bright, hopeful opening—testing the water but confident. Casual cadence. A slight lift at the end, inviting him in without pushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。工房の大家さん、知り合いだから紹介できる。
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good. The studio landlord is someone I know—I can introduce you.
lines.style: Easy, immediate yes. Warm and matter-of-fact. The comfort of someone who knows he can help. Slight nod in the voice on 'landlord.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 場所の近くにサーフィンスポットもあるんですよ。
lines.en: And there's a surfing spot not far from there too.
lines.style: Delighted reveal—like she's been saving this detail. Light, quick pace. A little conspiratorial, sharing something she thinks he'll like.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。海上がりにシャンプー持っていこう。
lines.en: Oh, good point. We should bring shampoo for after surfing then.
lines.style: Practical, grounded. Not lecturing—just thinking ahead out loud. Warm undertone. Quick, efficient delivery, like he's already picturing it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夜は名曲ライブハウス、ピラミッド型の照明が綺麗だって聞きました。
lines.en: And then at night there's this live music venue—I heard the lighting's really beautiful, pyramid-shaped fixtures everywhere.
lines.style: Building momentum. Genuine excitement bubbling through. Slight breathiness on the description. Pace picks up as she paints the scene, then softens on 'beautiful.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: The owner has a great voice, actually. People talk about how good he is.
lines.style: Warm endorsement. Genuine, not overselling. Relaxed, confident tone—he knows what he's talking about. Slight settling-in quality, like this is the perfect closing note.
